facts.fact: Expertise France's project page, published 2026-02-17, says its EU-funded project (running August 2024 to August 2027) works with ESTDEV to improve and align Botswana's National Interoperability framework, standards, guidelines and tools, and lists a 'harmonised and operational national interoperability framework for e-government services' as an expected result; the page does not say the framework has been adopted or issued, and its date is the page's published date.

systems.owner: Government of Botswana, supported by Expertise France and ESTDEV

facts.fact: Section 12 of the Digital Services Act, 2025 (No. 22, assented 2025-10-17, commencement by Ministerial Order) requires the Digital Services Authority to establish a standardised Framework for Secure Exchange of Information ensuring secure communication, identity verification, data integrity and interoperability; the Act does not say the framework has been issued, and its date is the assent date.
